SELECT q.qna_NUM AS qnaNum, q.q_Title AS title, q.q_Question AS question, TO_CHAR(q.q_Reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDate, q.a_Answer AS answer, TO_CHAR(q.a_Reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS answerRegDate, q.memberIdx AS memberIdx, q.q_Type AS type, m.userId AS userId, m.userName AS userName FROM QnA q JOIN member1 m ON q.memberIdx = m.memberIdx WHERE q.qna_NUM = #{qnaNum}
